digest.component_or_area: LLM structured run and request header delivery
propositions: Request headers resolved from ${run:...} references must reach the wire via pydantic-ai's ModelSettings.extra_headers by extending build_model_settings return value.
Headers are delivered only when cfg.base_url is set; they are inert on Bedrock and gated against public providers to prevent operator-internal values reaching external services.
A fresh dict must be passed per call, never the config-held mapping, to prevent mutation by upstream httpx transport and pollution of provenance records across calls.
Header names carrying ${run:...} substitends are omitted entirely outside gate-run scope when the run value is absent, rather than sent empty or raising an error.
Header values are never recorded; provenance captures only the sorted list of configured header names via provenance_for, with values redacted from all logs and diagnostics.
Validation is re-applied after ${run:...} substitution at call time to close the validate-before-substitute gap, rejecting values that become unsafe after resolution.
